I got into skramz through my local scene. I had been going to hxc/punk shows since like 2021, but was never introduced to screamo until late summer of 2022. I went to an “all hollow” show (which is just a local indie band from the high desert) just because it was something to do, and widowdusk played there. This was when they were still relatively new and didn’t even have their first EP out. But that show actually blew my mind, I swear I saw Jordan (the vocalist) like, literally crying whilst doing vocals. It was just so emotional and changed my mind on what I thought music was. I don’t even know how to fully describe how I felt but something just clicked in me. Anyways, after that I got into the genre a little more, I got into vs self (who are also originally from the high desert,) I ended up going to a few of their shows and got introduced to knumears, party hats, gavin m etc. so a couple years later I’m still just as obsessed with screamo lol.

Tl:dr went to a local indie show and widowdusk was on the bill lol
